planemo.id_note: Galaxy encodes integer ids the same way in every table, so an invocation and a history (or the workflow) with the same integer id share one string. Planemo's JSON reports the same value for invocation_id and history_id.

galaxy.staging: Test BAMs are fetched by Galaxy from the GitHub raw URLs in the test file and checked against the SHA-1 hashes there. Tools come from the workflow's Tool Shed pins and biocontainers. Galaxy builds the BAM index as dataset metadata; the samtools commands read it as infile.bai.
